# RS CONSTRUCTIONS building material Supplier in kandivali- Mumbai

RS CONSTRUCTIONS building material Supplier is Mumbai-based provider of high-quality construction materials, serving contractors, builders, and infrastructure projects across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, and the surrounding suburbs.

## Core Products
- **Aggregates:** Available in 10mm, 20mm, and 40mm sizes for RCC work, concrete mixing, and road construction.
- **Stone Chips:** High-grade, uniform grading for superior concrete strength and foundation work.
- **Crushed Sand (M-Sand):** Manufactured sand suitable for plastering, concrete mixing, and masonry.
- **River Sand:** Natural river sand with optimal fineness modulus for fine concrete work and plastering.
- **GSB Material:** Granular Sub-Base material for road base and pavement construction.
- **Construction Fill:** Quality backfilling and site preparation material.

## Key Service Highlights
- **Coverage:** Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Western & Central Suburbs.
- **Key Features:** Assured quality & grading, competitive pricing, 24/7 on-time delivery, and same-day delivery options.
- **Experience:** 15+ years serving 500+ builders and contractors.
